Class ViewFlow

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.ViewFlow
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventReceiver
public class ViewFlow extends Object implements EventReceiver
The ViewFlow class is responsible for managing the flow of logic and events in the client-side application. It serves as a bridge between the GUI/TUI views and the server, handling user input, managing game states, and sending or receiving events
